thread:
Maria: quick FYI — after merging tokenizer v2 for q4b, our dedupe fingerprints don't match historical hashes; golden set shows ~12% duplicates that weren't flagged earlier. pulling thread for plan.
Ajay: what's the repro? can you paste the pipeline command and sample ids?
Maria: repro steps:
```
# use tokenizer v2
python -m dedupe.compute_fingerprint --tokenizer v2 --seedfile seeds/2026-03-15.csv --out fp_v2.ndjson
python -m dedupe.compare --baseline fp_v1.ndjson --new fp_v2.ndjson --summary summary.json
```
I can share the small sample subset — about 8k rows. see diff: `summary.json` shows 12.1% items with changed fingerprint.
Taylor: hmm — probably whitespace/tokenization changes shift token boundaries; we'll need to rehash with the new tokenizer for all golden candidates and re-run dedupe. two options: (A) run full regen (expensive) or (B) incremental: rehash only candidates + neighbors in LSH buckets. sgtm to try B first.
Ajay: agree. B first. do we have an estimate for runtime? how many buckets?
Maria: estimate: candidates ~50k, neighbors ~~300k total entries. local bench: `python -m dedupe.compute_fingerprint` ~ 1.2ms/row on CPU per core; cluster job w/ 32 cores ~ 10 min for 300k. plus dedupe pass ~20 min. I'll kick a job.
curation-bot: Job started: rehash-candidates-3476543210 (user: Maria) · status: queued :hourglass: 
Nate: I can reassign 4 labelers to audit the rehashed golden diffs. prefer to batch by priority: long-context > multilingual > code examples. labeler-ops ok?
Maria: yes. priority buckets: long-context (>512 tokens), multi-turn (>3 turns), non-en (priority languages: es, fr, de, ja), code-snippets (python/js).
Taylor: also flag items where tokenized length changed by >25% — those probably trigger semantics shift. I can add a filter step.
Ajay: for model onboarding: once we have rehashed golden and dedup fixed, let's run a 5k eval comparing q4b-v1 (quant-old) vs q4b-v2 (tokenizer v2 + quant). metrics: EM/ROUGE/embedding-sim diff + hallucination rate on golden. timeline? Aim for end of day tomorrow?
Maria: EOD tomorrow works if compute lands in 30m. labelers will take ~6 hours for 3k audit units; Nate will confirm. After that, we run eval harness: `./eval/run_compare.sh --models q4b-v1,q4b-v2 --prompts golden_5k.json --out eval_v2.json`
Nate: labelers confirmed. putting task in queue with tag `golden-tokenhash-resync` and priority high. ETA for labels: 6-7h. I'll post updates in #curation-ops if anything blocks.
Ajay: great. if dedupe shows >10% behavioral diffs after regen we should consider rolling back tokenizer in model infra until we complete a larger sweep. but let's see.
Maria: noted. proceeding with incremental rehash + dedupe. will post job IDs and sample diffs here. :thumbsup: 
Taylor: adding a lightweight smoke eval for the top 200 diffs before full labeling. saves cycles.
Maria: thanks — kicking smoke now. next sync in ~2 hours or when smoke completes.
